requirements.title: Provider-description evidence selection
requirements.description: Automatic provider selection uses the query and registry natural-language descriptions as evidence without provider-specific routing code. Search Hub uses its active retrieval strategy and a bounded description shortlist when the semantic index is available; the lexical path is an explicit fallback.

validation.notes: Against the composed router.routing suite, routing recall@K >= 0.85; per-provider breakdown and precision reported.
Adding or updating a registry description changes routing evidence without per-provider routing code.

requirements.title: Evidence ambiguity and explicit override
requirements.description: Automatic selection reports ambiguity or missing positive provider evidence explicitly. Explicit --type/--all override automatic selection; --explain exposes routing rationale.

validation.notes: An ambiguous query preserves bounded evidence and a typed ambiguity reason rather than conflating ambiguity with provider degradation.

requirements.title: Bounded provider-description retrieval
requirements.description: The router shall retrieve only a bounded provider-description shortlist through the shared embedding contract, persist descriptor vectors with model metadata, and name routing_index_unavailable when deterministic relevance-scored enumeration is used as the fallback.

validation.notes: The index returns a bounded shortlist and records omitted providers.
Persisted descriptor vectors are reused across restart and only changed descriptors are re-embedded.
Unavailable embedding falls back with the stable routing_index_unavailable reason.
